candidates.sentence: In the halls of Congress, I have never backed down from the battles to protect and defend our democracy, preserve and expand our fundamental rights, and end the scourge of gun violence.”
Dan will work to support and expand scholarships, student aid, public interest debt forgiveness programs, and pathways to success.
Dan will defend Social Security and ensure that benefits keep up with the rising cost of living.

In Congress, one of Dan’s first orders of business will be to introduce legislation to double the number of immigration judges in our system and streamline the asylum process so that we don’t have a backlog of asylum-seekers in inhumane conditions.
Dan supports an immediate expansion of monthly Social Security benefits.
Dan firmly believes in the need to expand healthcare access, and supports expanding Medicare by lowering eligibility to age 60 and allowing people 55 and older to buy in.

Dan supports reforming and streamlining the immigration process by improving language accessibility for immigrant services, dedicating more resources to hiring USCIS caseworkers to speed up applications, and pushing for more funding for services for recent immigrants, including language classes and workforce development.
He also firmly believes that undocumented immigrants must have a pathway to citizenship.
